reading.zh: 按启动链跑的顺序读：一头一尾是进程处理与原子写原语，中间依次是签名 → 注入库 → loader 运行时 → DLSS5 注入目标 → add-on → EFMI 全局，最后才是序列本体（core）—— 因为它是把这些一个个叫起来的那一环。
reading.en: Read it as the launch chain runs: processes and atomic-IO primitives at the edges, then signing → injection library → loader runtime → DLSS5 targets → add-ons → EFMI globals, and the sequence itself (core) last, because it is what calls all of them.
